# systeam_check (Resource)

Manages a health check.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Check name.
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID that owns this check.
- `type` (String) Check type.

### Optional

- `alert_after_failures` (Number) Number of consecutive failures before alerting.
- `api_scenario_secrets` (String, Sensitive) Secrets for api_scenario steps as a JSON object. Write-only: encrypted server-side, never read back.
- `api_scenario_steps` (String) Multi-step API scenario definition as JSON (api_scenario checks).
- `assigned_agent_id` (Number) ID of the private agent assigned to this check.
- `assigned_agent_ids` (List of Number) IDs of agents assigned to this check (multi/geo monitoring).
- `auth_bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) HTTP bearer token. Write-only: encrypted server-side, never read back.
- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method (uptime checks). Server default: NONE.
- `auth_password` (String, Sensitive) HTTP basic-auth password. Write-only: encrypted server-side, never read back.
- `auth_username` (String) HTTP basic-auth username.
- `check_source_critical` (String) Per-source criticality config as JSON.
- `content_change_enabled` (Boolean) Alert when the response content changes unexpectedly.
- `content_change_severity` (String) notify, degraded, or down.
- `content_ignore_patterns` (List of String) Regex patterns to ignore when detecting content changes (e.g. timestamps).
- `content_match_attribute` (String) Attribute to read when content_match_extract is attribute (e.g. href). Requires content_match_selector.
- `content_match_case_sensitive` (Boolean) Case-sensitive content match.
- `content_match_enabled` (Boolean) Enable response content matching.
- `content_match_extract` (String) What to read from the selected elements: text or attribute. Requires content_match_selector.
- `content_match_selector` (String) CSS selector scoping the match to part of the page. Required by content_match_type equals/exists/not_exists and by content_match_extract/content_match_attribute.
- `content_match_text` (String) Text or regex to match in the response.
- `content_match_type` (String) contains, not_contains, regex, equals, exists, or not_exists. The last three require content_match_selector.
- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression (heartbeat checks).
- `cron_timezone` (String) Cron timezone (heartbeat checks). Server default: UTC.
- `db_expected_result` (String) Expected query result for validation (database checks).
- `db_host` (String) Database host (database checks).
- `db_name` (String) Database name (database checks).
- `db_password` (String, Sensitive) Database password (database checks). Write-only: encrypted at rest and never returned by the API, so it is not refreshed into state.
- `db_port` (Number) Database port (database checks).
- `db_query` (String) Query to execute (database checks).
- `db_ssl_enabled` (Boolean) Use SSL/TLS for the database connection (database checks).
- `db_type` (String) Database engine (database checks): postgresql, mysql, mongodb, redis.
- `db_username` (String) Database username (database checks).
- `description` (String) Check description.
- `dns_dkim_selector` (String) DKIM selector to check.
- `dns_expected_ips` (List of String) Expected IPs for DNS-hijacking detection (dns checks).
- `dns_expected_value` (String) Expected DNS record value (dns checks).
- `dns_hijack_alert_channel_ids` (String) Channel IDs for hijack alerts.
- `dns_hijack_alert_enabled` (Boolean) Enable DNS-hijacking alerts.
- `dns_multi_record_enabled` (Boolean) Enable multi-record DNS monitoring.
- `dns_record_type` (String) DNS record type to query (dns checks). Server default: A.
- `dns_records_config` (String) Per-record config for multi-record DNS monitoring as JSON.
- `dns_server` (String) DNS server to query (dns checks).
- `dns_soa_alert_on_change` (Boolean) Alert when the SOA serial changes.
- `dns_txt_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Enable TXT (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) monitoring.
- `escalation_policy_id` (Number) ID of the escalation policy.
- `expected_status_codes` (List of Number) Accepted HTTP status codes (uptime checks). Defaults to [200] server-side.
- `ftp_passive` (Boolean) Use passive mode.
- `ftp_password` (String, Sensitive) FTP password. Write-only: encrypted server-side, never read back.
- `ftp_path` (String) Path to list/verify.
- `ftp_protocol` (String) FTP, FTPS or SFTP.
- `ftp_username` (String) FTP username (empty for anonymous).
- `geo_content_consistency_enabled` (Boolean) Alert when geo-distributed agents see inconsistent content.
- `geo_monitoring_enabled` (Boolean) Enable geo-distributed monitoring.
- `grace_period` (Number) Grace period in seconds before marking as down.
- `host` (String) Host to check (icmp, tcp, udp, dns, ftp checks).
- `http_body` (String) Request body (POST/PUT/PATCH).
- `http_body_type` (String) Request body type: none, json, form, raw.
- `http_follow_redirects` (Boolean) Follow HTTP redirects.
- `http_form_check_after_login_url` (String) URL to check after logging in.
- `http_form_login_data` (String, Sensitive) Form fields for HTTP form login as a JSON object, e.g. jsonencode({username="u",password="p"}). Write-only: holds credentials, never read back from the API.
- `http_form_login_enabled` (Boolean) Authenticate via an HTML form before checking.
- `http_form_login_success_text` (String) Text confirming successful login.
- `http_form_login_url` (String) URL to POST the login form to.
- `http_headers` (String, Sensitive) Custom HTTP request headers as a JSON object, e.g. jsonencode({"X-Api-Key"="..."}).
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method (uptime checks). Server default: GET.
- `interval` (Number) Check interval in seconds.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the check is active.
- `mail_blacklist_servers` (String) Comma-separated RBL servers.
- `mail_check_blacklist` (Boolean) Check RBL blacklists.
- `mail_check_dkim` (Boolean) Check DKIM.
- `mail_check_dmarc` (Boolean) Check DMARC.
- `mail_check_ptr` (Boolean) Check reverse DNS (PTR).
- `mail_check_spf` (Boolean) Check SPF record.
- `mail_dkim_selectors` (String) Comma-separated DKIM selectors.
- `mail_domain` (String) Mail domain to check (mail checks).
- `mail_imap_enabled` (Boolean) Check IMAP.
- `mail_imap_port` (Number) IMAP port (143/993).
- `mail_imap_ssl` (Boolean) Use IMAP SSL.
- `mail_pop3_enabled` (Boolean) Check POP3.
- `mail_pop3_port` (Number) POP3 port (110/995).
- `mail_pop3_ssl` (Boolean) Use POP3 SSL.
- `mail_smtp_enabled` (Boolean) Check SMTP.
- `mail_smtp_open_relay` (Boolean) Check for an open relay.
- `mail_smtp_port` (Number) SMTP port (25/465/587).
- `mail_smtp_starttls` (Boolean) Check STARTTLS support.
- `oidc_config` (String) OIDC identity-provider check configuration as JSON (oidc checks).
- `ping_count` (Number) Number of ICMP pings to send.
- `port` (Number) Port number (tcp, udp, ftp checks).
- `response_assertions` (String) Response assertions as a JSON array (http/uptime checks).
- `runbook_url` (String) Runbook URL surfaced on incidents for this check.
- `schedule_type` (String) Schedule type (heartbeat checks). Server default: interval.
- `ssl_verify` (Boolean) Verify SSL certificate.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds.
- `traceroute_on_timeout` (Boolean) Run traceroute automatically on timeout.
- `url` (String) URL to check (uptime checks).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Check ID.
